title: 第9章 范小胖
content_zh:
杀青宴上，曹郁和赵祥他们，刻意和谷川保持了距离，像是在掩饰什么一样。

    谷川也不刻意去找他们。

    都已经进了自己口袋了，不用管他们，还不如去联系一下那些还没有勾搭上的人。

    华谊的王忠磊也来了。

    他举着酒杯，笑着对谷川说道：“《英雄》14号首映，你要不要去。”

    “去啊。”谷川说道：“第一部国产商业大片，这种划时代的作品，当然要去看看。

    那些老一辈的导演，就老谋子还算不错了，这种电影对中国电影是有重大意义的。”

    他还没有忘自己拯救国产电影的初心。

    王忠磊对谷川嘴里的‘意义’不感兴趣，只想知道能有多少票房。

    《英雄》的首映礼可是在人民大会堂，让王忠磊羡慕的眼珠子都红了。

    他低声问道：“你认为《英雄》能有多少票房？”

    “2亿打底吧。”谷川说道。

    “你可真敢说。”王忠磊嗤笑一声。

    “你要相信南加州大学导演系天才的判断。”谷川说道。

    王忠磊说道：“我更相信国内的市场。”

    国产电影？2亿打底？

    你做梦呢。

    “你还是不专业了。”谷川笑了笑。

    王忠磊和他说了《英雄》首映的事情之后，就不再多聊了。

    邀请他的事情，也是新画面的张老板提的。

    那位张老板知道了谷川是南加州大学的，在好莱坞有点人脉，想找他过去帮忙。

    现在老谋子一心想要冲击奥斯卡，什么手段都想用一下。

    杀青宴结束，谷川开始继续写剧本。

    他写的剧本不是自己要拍摄的剧本，而是用来骗投资的。

    “现在是2002年12月。”谷川小声的嘟囔了一声。

    他开始想自己电影的女主。

    他已经想好了，这次的女主一定要找一个知名度大的。

    但他认识的女明星，好像就刘艺菲一个人。

    “才2002年啊。”谷川有些遗憾。

    刘艺菲的《金粉世家》还没开播，《天龙八部》正在拍摄，现在的她可没什么名气。

    但有枣没枣先打两竿。

    ……
content_en:
At the closing banquet, Cao Yu and Zhao Xiang deliberately kept a distance from Gu Chuan, as if they were hiding something.

    Tanichuan didn't bother to look for them either.

    It’s all in your own pocket, so don’t worry about them, why not contact those you haven’t hooked up with yet.

    Wang Zhonglei from Huayi also came.

    He raised his glass and said to Tanigawa with a smile: ""Hero" premieres on the 14th, do you want to go?"

    "Go." Tanichuan said: "The first domestic commercial blockbuster, such an epoch-making work, of course you have to see it.

    Among the directors of the older generation, Lao Mouzi is pretty good. This kind of film is of great significance to Chinese cinema. "

    He has not forgotten his original intention to save domestic films.

    Wang Zhonglei was not interested in the 'meaning' of Tan Chuan's words, he just wanted to know how much box office it would get.

    The premiere of "Hero" was held in the Great Hall of the People, which made Wang Zhonglei's eyes turn red with envy.

    He asked in a low voice: "How much box office do you think "Hero" can have?"

    "Let's start with 200 million," Tanichuan said.

    "How dare you say that." Wang Zhonglei sneered.

    "You have to trust the judgment of the genius of the directing department at the University of Southern California." Tanigawa said.

    Wang Zhonglei said: "I believe more in the domestic market."

    Domestic movies? 200 million bottom line?

    You are dreaming.

    "You are still unprofessional." Tanichuan smiled.

    After Wang Zhonglei told him about the premiere of "Hero", he stopped talking to him.

    The invitation to him was also brought up by Boss Zhang from New Picture.

    Boss Zhang knew that Tanichuan was from the University of Southern California and had some connections in Hollywood, so he wanted to ask him to help.

    Now Lao Mouzi is determined to win the Oscar, and he wants to use any means.

    After the closing party, Tanichuan began to continue writing the script.

    The script he wrote was not the script he wanted to shoot, but was used to defraud investors.

    "It is December 2002." Tanichuan muttered quietly.

    He started thinking about the heroine of his movie.

    He has already decided that the heroine this time must be someone well-known.

    But the only female celebrity he knew was Liu Yifei.

    "It was only 2002." Tanichuan said regretfully.

    Liu Yifei's "A Family" has not yet started airing, and "Dragon" is currently being filmed. She is not famous now.

    But if there are dates but there are no dates, hit two poles first.

    …
